observations: The chunk (audit/AUDIT-1.2.42.md lines 1148-1166) holds 19 numbered items, 274-292, and no block header. The nearest block header above is line 1077, 'Po E77 (1.2.76 ...)', and the next non-item line after it is line 1658: every item from line 1078 on, these 19 among them, sits under a header that names E77, though their heads name H81 (1.2.81), H82 (1.2.82), E19 and E18 (1.2.83). The stage of each item here is taken from its LIVE id and its bold head, not from a header.

H81 and H82 are not ids in tools/stages.json (E18 and E19 are, both version 1.2.83, shipped 2026-10-24). The release notes call them 'Stage E85 in full: H81' (.github/release-notes/v1.2.81.md:3) and 'Stage E86 in full: H82' (.github/release-notes/v1.2.82.md:3).

The ids are not in order inside the chunk: E19 runs 06, 07, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 08, 09, 10 (items 281-290) and E18 runs 04, 03 (items 291-292), with LIVE-E18-01 and -02 following as items 293 and 294.

One of the 19 has a recorded reading on a real Foundry: 274 (LIVE-H81-03), and that reading covers the update options of moves made through the API (part (d)) and, through the LIVE-E39-01 move, one update a route (part (e)); no drag by mouse, no tunnel and no region teleport was read. docs/dev/e58/TRIAGE-9.2.md:297 gives it class M ('measured') and LOCAL-REPORT.md:327 counts it as measured whole.

The triage gives class K (checkable by script on the sandbox) to 281, 284, 285 and 291 and S to 277, 278, 290 and 292; none of the eight is in LOCAL-REPORT.md's list of rows measured (:327), so they are among its 397 rows 'left' (:331). The other ten are T: The Forge, a real LiveKit server or real audio.

Seven ids of the chunk are cited by nothing in scripts/ or audit/harness/: LIVE-E19-02, -03, -04, -05, -08, -09 and -10 occur only in the audit, in .github/release-notes/v1.2.83.md and in TRIAGE-9.2.md (git grep, 20.11.2026), so no code comment or test sends a reader to those items.

Six of the 19 quote user-facing words that later text stages changed: the dice-look setting's name and shape (275, 279: E108, v1.2.112), the Polish tunnel labels (277: E57, v1.2.113), the Polish name of the Passages tab (277, 278: E66 C5, v1.2.96), the dead player's tile line (287: E62 C3b, v1.2.112), the Polish wordsElsewhere line (291: E71 B12, v1.2.113) and the 'Allow it' button (292: E68 C9, v1.2.104). Two carry expectations a later decision of the owner reversed or replaced: 287 (the shared dead channel and a public death to the main room; E72 C8 and E62 C3b) and 292 (the notice tile under or over the windows by the kind of card; E44 C8c, the notices by theme).

Items 275, 276 (e), 279 (a) and 280 (a) ask for a comparison of 1.2.81 with 1.2.82; at 1.2.118 that reading needs two old builds installed at a table, and the items do not say whether the comparison is still wanted.
